I'm on the OSM main map. I should search for "Whole Foods" (there are probably several results; pick the one near Carnegie Mellon = Pittsburgh). Let me search in the search box.

First subgoal: type "Whole Foods" into the search box and execute the search. Assign a set_value to the search field, then click Go. Probably one subgoal per turn — let me just set the value first.

Assign: {"field": "Search", "value": "Whole Foods"} — the operation is set_value.

Next, expected: the page should display search results. In practice, the search probably navigates to /search?query=.... Set expected's url_contains to "search".
